get_video_feed.description: Extract structured video entries from Douyin feed, search results, or user profile. Supports JSON and Excel-compatible CSV export.

max_items.description: Maximum number of video items to extract (default: 10).

export_format.description: Output format: 'json' or 'csv' (default: 'json'). CSV includes UTF-8 BOM for direct Excel compatibility.

get_video_feed.returns: JSON array or CSV string of video objects (video_id, title, author, likes, url).
